# Checklist

- [x] I want to remove an existing member from a team
- [ ] I have started this PR from a branch, not a fork
- [ ] I have modified the relevant `teams/*.yml` file
- [ ] Choose one of these:
  - [ ] I'm moving myself to emeritus
  - [ ] I'm removing someone else who is provenly inactive
  - [ ] I'm removing someone else and a vote has taken place
- [ ] A link to this PR has been added to the membership metadata
- [ ] CI is passing
